exact_statement: The v1 disjoint-core and priority-control theorem is retained. For a Boolean sign controller a(W), c=(1-a)/2, p=Ec, V=4p(1-p), and Boolean G(S,X),H(S,Y) on mutually disjoint uniform blocks W,S,X,Y, set F=cG+(1-c)H and d=P(G!=H). With phi(r)=r log2(1/r), Hplus(a)=sum nonempty phi(ahat(U)^2), A=1/(e ln2), B=3/ln2+2, shared conditional-mean Fourier vectors u,v, vG=1-||u||2^2, vH=1-||v||2^2 and sigma=sum shared-only |uT^2-vT^2|, Pi=H(F)-pH(G)-(1-p)H(H)<=d Hplus(a)+V[A(vG+vH+sigma)+B d]. If ||u||1,||v||1<=Lambda, Pi<=d Hplus(a)+[4A(1+Lambda)+B]Vd; coefficients are <11 for one shared bit and <13 for two. I(F)=pI(G)+(1-p)I(H)+dI(a). Given normalized finite-cost seed references, calibration of EVERY shared-only atom yields one normalized compatible root reference Q with D(PF||Q)=pD(PG||RGcal)+(1-p)D(PH||RHcal), and CE(PF,Q)=p CE(PG,RGcal)+(1-p)CE(PH,RHcal)+Pi. All local assertions survive physical coordinate restrictions after recomputation; inherited-reference reset payment and universal terminal FEI are not asserted.
hypotheses: Finite independent uniform sign blocks W,S,X,Y; only S may occur in both branches
Branches and controller sign Boolean, with arbitrary output means; entropy in bits
Seed references normalized and positive on true support; every shared-only atom calibrated; remaining terminal conditional debt retained
No arbitrary-event conditioning; restriction claims concern actual uniform subcubes
Profile norm hypotheses required only for the stated constant admission; no all-dimensional absolute collision price or reset telescope

proof_dependencies.role: retained disjoint and priority assertions only; new scalar and reference formulas proved directly
